name: Terra Clean Energy Corp.
summary: Tisdale Clean Energy Corp. operates as a junior exploration firm, engaged in the identification, acquisition, investigation, and appraisal of mineral properties across North America. Its principal holding is the Keefe Lake uranium project, an asset it fully owns, which spans approximately 15,400 hectares within the eastern Athabasca basin of northeastern Saskatchewan. Established in 1972 and based in Vancouver, Canada, the company adopted its current name, Tisdale Clean Energy Corp., in June 2022, having previously been known as Tisdale Resources Corp.
